body.p: Once a fox came to a human, who was about to go by boat. The fox asked the human: "Hey, human! Take me along on your boat". The human put all kind of food into a bag: fat and dried meat. The human said to the fox: "If you know the names of the lands, sit down." The fox said to the human: "Just cover me with something". The human covered his friend. The fox sat down in [the human's] boat. The went off. Having reached a river reach, the human asked the fox: "How is the name of this river reach?" The fox said: "It's name is "Upper"." Then they went on, to another river reach. There the human asked the fox again: "Fox, what's the name of this river reach?" That one said: "It's name is "Middle"." Again they went on, to the third river reach. Having reached the third one, the human asked: "What's the name of this river reach?" The fox said: "Lower". They landed at the shore. The fox jumped from the boat onto the shore. So it disappeared, taking along the small sack. The fox, going, met a bear [lit. Mixail Ivanovich[DCh]: "Mihail Ivanovich" is a taboo expression for the bear.] at some place. Then they started to talk, having met the first time. The bear [lit. Mikhail Ivanovich] asked: "Where did you find such tasty food?" The fox said to the bear: "I found it in a small lake, putting my tail into the water. Putting my tail in water, it turned into tallow". The fox said to its friend: "Hold your tail in water like me, too". Together they came to the small lake, which was just freezing. The bear put its tail into the small lake. When he had put [it] in water, its tail froze heavily. Then the bear [lit. Mikhail Ivanovich] started to struggle, he couldn't get loose anyhow. When he was pulling and struggling with all its strength, it tore off its tail. There is no sack on its tail. The fox had betrayed him. Until now he has no tail.
